CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Painting and Collage: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Collage.
   B. Practise Painting and Collage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Collage.
   D. Damage equipment used for Painting and Collage.

2. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.
   C. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.
   D. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Best practice when working on Rhythm and Pattern Making: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm and Pattern Making with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm and Pattern Making.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm and Pattern Making.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm and Pattern Making.

4. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   C. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.

5. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the costume
   D. The speed of the music

6. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.

7. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.

   D. Disrupt classmates during Melody.

8. Best practice when working on String Musical Instruments and Drawing: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during String Musical Instruments and Drawing.
   B. Practise String Musical Instruments and Drawing with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for String Musical Instruments and Drawing.
   D. Refuse all feedback on String Musical Instruments and Drawing.

9. Best practice when working on Volleyball: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Volleyball.
   B. Practise Volleyball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Volleyball.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Volleyball.

10. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.
   C. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.

11. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   C. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.

12. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.
   C. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.

13. Best practice when working on Weaving: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Weaving.
   B. Practise Weaving with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Weaving.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Weaving.

14. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Remove the need for rules

15. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Volleyball and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm and Pattern Making and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Weaving and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Gymnastics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Athletics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
